summary: Judge of common pleas, assemblyman 1795, of Sagtikos Manor/Apple-Tree Neck, Islip; John's 2nd cousin 9x removed.
bio:
Path: John Thompson → Samuel → Jonathan (1710–86) → Isaac.

Son of Jonathan Thompson (1710-86) and Mary Woodhull, grandson of Samuel Thompson ([R4-S2]): 2nd cousin 9 times removed via John Thompson. Magistrate for more than forty years, judge of common pleas and assemblyman ([R4-S1]). His wife made their children Bull Smith cousins too.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 470 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
[R4-S2] B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 297 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyoflongisl003thom
